About This Game

The ultimate contest of speed and wit...

In New Metropolis, a futuristic animal city, data crime has become the number one threat in the underground world. A group of animal hackers known as the "Black Keyers" wantonly plunder wealth and power by tampering with the city's transportation systems, financial networks, and even public safety protocols. They can breach firewalls in a split second, yet they cannot escape an ancient and fatal flaw...

And that is!

The ultimate limit of human hand speed!

In the digital age, speed and precision are not only survival skills, but also weapons to uphold justice. In the end, the animals will understand that the true "race against time" lies not in the frequency of keyboard taps, but in the courage and wisdom behind every choice...

Integrating typing competition and chase confrontation, players can freely choose to play as a policeman (chasing thieves) or a thief (escaping). Typing speed directly determines the character's movement efficiency; continuous error-free input can trigger an exclusive acceleration effect. Combined with interesting props such as roadblocks and banana peels, as well as a randomly refreshed vehicle system, each battle is full of strategy and fun.

Supports three global real-time matching modes: 1V1, 2V2, and 1V3. AI intelligent fill-in ensures that you can play anytime. It integrates more than 50 carefully designed achievement systems, synchronously linked to Steam Achievements and Cloud Save. While enjoying the game, you can accumulate honors, creating a competitive environment that balances fairness and a sense of accomplishment.

Adopts 2D Q-version cute and funny pet character designs, with transition scenes focusing on the rendering of intense chase battle images. The main interface is paired with relaxed and cheerful background music, and the in-game rhythm switches to a tense pace as the battle progresses. Combined with interesting skill sound effects, it creates an all-round immersive casual competitive experience.

The game builds a multi-dimensional growth system that is both challenging and interesting. Whether you accumulate chasing thieves, successfully escape, or flexibly use props such as roadblocks and banana peels to complete designated tasks, you can unlock more than 50 unique achievements and simultaneously gain generous in-game currency. The store offers a variety of exchange options, from character outfits and vehicle skins to skill props, making every chase and escape full of freshness.
